name: openssl/openssl
description: The definitive open-source TLS/SSL and cryptographic library, powering the majority of HTTPS traffic on the internet. Includes libssl for protocol implementations, libcrypto for cryptographic primitives, and command-line tools for certificate management and encryption.
score_rationale: Industry-standard cryptographic library used by the vast majority of internet infrastructure, with nearly 30k stars and continuous active development.
